item.title: Topology-Guided Vortices in a Polariton Condensate
item.description:
Nature Materials, Published online: 11 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41563-026-02693-5

A perovskite quasi-bound state in the continuum metasurface with broken in-plane inversion symmetry generates topology-driven spin polaritons, in which condensation and spin–orbit coupled half-vortex pairs are governed by the cavity geometry.
